description: Real-time crypto prices, market caps, and 24h % changes via CoinGecko. Pass coins as CoinGecko IDs (['bitcoin','ethereum','solana']) or tickers. Max 25 coins per call. Returns usd, usd_24h_change, usd_market_cap per coin. Add currencies param for multi-currency output (['usd','eur','gbp']). Price: $0.002 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"coins":["bitcoin","ethereum"],"currencies":["usd"]}.

coins.description: List of coin IDs or ticker symbols. Accepts CoinGecko IDs (e.g. 'bitcoin', 'ethereum') or common tickers (e.g. 'BTC', 'ETH', 'SOL'). Max 25 coins per call.

currencies.description: Target fiat currencies. Default: ['usd']. Supported: usd, eur, gbp, jpy, chf, aud, cad, btc, eth.

name: crypto_prices
